title: OTel SRE-Copilot
tagline: An LLM agent that investigates Kubernetes incidents from OpenTelemetry metrics, traces and logs, with citations checked against tool calls.
problem: During an incident an on-call engineer has to correlate dashboards, traces, logs and Kubernetes events across a dozen services before finding the one that broke. LLM agents promise to automate this, but they are rarely measured against simple anomaly-detection baselines and they can invent evidence.
approach: Telemetry fingerprints rank service and fault pairs. A LangGraph agent can reorder those candidates using Prometheus, Tempo, Loki and Kubernetes events. Unsupported diagnoses are removed; remaining slots use the grounded prior. The benchmark uses recorded Astronomy Shop telemetry.

demo.caption: Replay of a recorded agent run on the checkout pod-crash incident: the tool calls, ranked root causes, the cited evidence with the grounding verifier's verdict, and the Chaos Mesh ground truth.
